subject: Payment failed on INV-2027-451 — virtual card decline / interim credit request
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <accounts@brightarc.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-22T09:14:00Z
Subject: Payment failed on INV-2027-451 — virtual card decline

Hi Sofia / Marissa,

We noticed the renewal payment for BrightArc (INV-2027-451) didn't go through this morning. Our finance team received a decline from the virtual card we supplied via our T&E provider; the error message on our side is "card_declined: restricted_bin". I attached a screenshot from our card portal showing the decline response.

Can you confirm if Redwood can attempt another authorization (we can rotate the virtual card) or if you need us to put through a wire/PO in the short term? We're trying to avoid service disruption while our procurement runs a new corporate card (this may take ~10 business days).

Also, our AP team can share VAT documentation if needed (we're EU-registered - VAT ID: EU123456789).

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Finance, BrightArc Systems
attachments: decline_screenshot.png

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Gomez <accounts@brightarc.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-22T09:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment failed on INV-2027-451 — virtual card decline

Thanks for the heads up, Alicia — we appreciate the detail.

We're going to do two things immediately:
- Log the decline with our payments ops team and attempt a single retry once you confirm the rotated virtual card is active.
- Put a manual hold on service suspension for 72 hours to avoid an immediate outage while procurement completes the new card. If you do need longer than 72 hours, let us know and we'll escalate.

Can you send the rotated card token (last 4 digits + expiration) or confirm when the new virtual card is live? Also please attach the VAT certificate so finance can reconcile the invoice metadata.

I'll loop in Marissa from Payments Ops to check fallback routes (PSP routing / manual auth) and Priya in Billing for a possible interim credit if we need to cover unmet usage while the card is updated.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Developer-first LLM inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-22T10:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Payment failed on INV-2027-451 — notes from payments ops

Forwarding details from payments ops after quick triage:

- Stripe shows decline code: card_declined / issuer_declined (acquirer message: "Restricted BIN"). That aligns with the virtual card provider blocking merchant MCC or BIN.
- AVS mismatch was NOT the root cause (telephone trace shows authorized address matched).
- Recommended immediate actions: 1) Retry once after token rotation (one-shot), 2) If retry fails, run fallback via alternate PSP (we have a low-volume fallback pool for EU customers), 3) If both fail, request temporary service credit to prevent disruption while AP/Procurement resolves.

Risks: merchant-level 3DS/3DS exemption not relevant for virtual cards here; acquirer flag appears policy-based. If we see a chargeback after forced retries, we should collect chargeback-evidence pack quickly (signed SOW, previous invoices, communication trail).

I'm preparing a recommended retry plan and will name the scheduled retry window (we can do it this afternoon).

-Marissa
Head of Payments Ops
attachments: decline_codes_export.csv

From: Alicia Gomez <accounts@brightarc.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-22T12:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment failed on INV-2027-451 — virtual card decline

Thanks — we'll rotate the token now. Please schedule the one-shot retry this afternoon (anytime after 15:00 UTC works).

A couple of additional asks from our side:
- Could Redwood provision an interim credit against the invoice (or a partial credit memo) to cover 7 business days of service if the retry fails and procurement is delayed? Procurement is locked behind an internal approval that may take up to two weeks.
- I've attached our VAT certificate as requested. Please include our VAT ID on the revised invoice metadata: EU123456789.

Attached: vat_certificate_ba.pdf

Appreciate the quick response.

— Alicia

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Gomez <accounts@brightarc.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-22T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment failed on INV-2027-451 — virtual card decline / confirm retry + interim credit

Alicia — thanks for the VAT doc and for rotating the token. Quick update and next steps: 

1) Retry: Marissa will run the one-shot retry at 15:30 UTC today against the rotated token. If it passes, we'll mark INV-2027-451 as paid and share the auth receipt.

2) Interim credit: We've approved a short-term, one-off credit to avoid disruption while your procurement finishes. Finance will issue a provisional credit memo for €2,850 (approx. 7 days of average net usage) contingent on successful reconciliation once the payment settles or if you decide to pay via wire. Priya, can you please create the draft credit memo and share the PDF? I've added a proposed draft to the attachments for your review.

3) Chargeback/collection posture: if the retry is forced and we later receive a chargeback notification, Payments Ops will assemble an evidence package (SOW, signed MSA, usage logs, email thread). Alicia — please confirm who on your side is authorized to sign dispute waiver/collection forms if needed.

4) Invoice metadata: we've updated the invoice to include VAT ID EU123456789; I'll confirm final invoice meta in the follow-up.

Next: Marissa will post the retry result to this thread. If the retry fails, we'll immediately execute the fallback PSP attempt and keep the provisional credit in place until procurement completes.

Best regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed-credit-memo-draft.pdf
